corpus.provenance: official MIT-licensed openai/human-eval repository (data/HumanEval.jsonl); the HF mirror carries no license metadata and was excluded by G6

declarations.contamination: HumanEval sits in the training corpora of code LLMs (the Codex/StarCoder line) — product-quality reading, published anchors cited, never SOTA
declarations.holdout: one held-out read per arm; single-sample pass@1 (n=1, greedy)

config.prompt:
Complete the following Python function. Return only the function code, without any explanation or markdown fences.
{prompt}
config.question: Does a code-specialized checkpoint beat the generalist on HumanEval when graded by real execution, under the registered sandbox guard?

sandbox.environment_fingerprint: recorded in evidence (platform + python version + flags)
sandbox.grading: exec(candidate); run the problem's check(entry_point); a clean exit prints GEODE_CHECK_PASS
sandbox.isolation: subprocess python -I -B, no shell, timeout 5s, temp working directory

config.title: M268 cell 3: code specialist vs generalist, single-sample pass@1, HumanEval graded by sandboxed execution
